page.overview:
Who is Charm?

Charm is the placeholder name of a female unicorn with a lavender coat, violet mane and tail, and fuchsia pink eyes. Her cutie mark is unknown.__TOC__

Charm has the same design and dress design as "Gold Slipper" and S04E01 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1.

She first appears in The Best Night Ever as a guest at the Grand Galloping Gala. She is one of several chorus singers in At the Gala, and in the Gala ballroom, Pinkie Pie tries to encourage her to dance.

In Sweet and Elite, Charm appears several times during Becoming Popular (The Pony Everypony Should Know) and at the Canterlot Garden Party. She walks through Canterlot alongside "Sir Pony Moore" in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 1, and she attends both wedding ceremonies as well as the reception in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2.
